Name: Marnie sells grass seeds-bluegrass
Author: somewaixinren
Description:
[b]让我们说中文[/b]

没什么好说的，玛妮现在会出售草籽，比皮埃尔那里便宜
并且会售卖蓝草
考虑到蓝草的获取偏游戏后期，所以我把价格调高了一点点
（搞笑的是，我原来是打算修改皮埃尔的商店，但那个mod一直有bug，所以才让玛妮卖草籽）

[b]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English (Machine Translation)

[/b]There's nothing to say, Marnie will now sell grass seeds, cheaper than Pierre's
And will sell bluegrass
Considering that the acquisition of bluegrass is more late in the game, I raised the price a little bit
(Funnily enough, I was going to modify Pierre's shop, but that mod kept bugging, so I asked Marnie to sell grass seeds)
